document.selection: Fixed airport points reused from the earlier six-region station study. Nearest NWS-listed station before requesting forecasts; ties by station ID. No replacement after missing data or unfavorable results.
document.forecast: First captured identified daily GEFS product per point. Require actual receipt and source check at least six hours before target, initialization lead 6 through 120 hours, and all 31 finite temperature members. No later edition or retrospective substitution.
document.observations: After target plus 30 minutes, nearest NWS station temperature within 30 minutes; ties earlier. Require QC V/G and explicit Celsius/Fahrenheit units. Nearest missing/rejected reading stays missing; conflicting simultaneous readings excluded. Retain raw observation editions and retrieval times.
document.baseline: Freeze the latest station observation retrieved before the forecast request as persistence. Require QC V/G, valid temperature and age at most three hours at forecast receipt. No later replacement. Compare model and persistence on identical eligible cases.
document.aggregation: Keep all 144 planned station-times in coverage accounting. Report each station and disjoint initialization-lead groups 6-<24, 24-<48, 48-120 hours. Report model median MAE/bias, 10th-90th member inclusion/width and same-case persistence MAE. Overall means weight eligible stations equally, with station and pair denominators. Empty groups are null.
document.limits: One fixed convenience cohort, not independent regional/seasonal skill, calibrated probabilities, model ranking or personal exposure. Source hashes detect edits; they are not signatures or independent timestamps. No outcomes fetched during registration/capture.
